label: accepted

evidence.V1: Stepped stacked-strata outline is distinctive in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view reads as a layered slab.
evidence.V2: Clear big (stack) and medium (four offset strata with cut facets) levels, but no small detail (chips, cracks, pebbles), so only partial hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised strata with offset, tilted slabs and tapering stack; good chunky proportions.
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers on every slab edge catch the light in the strata and top close-ups.
evidence.V5: Close-ups clean: designed flat facets, no pinches, seams or z-fighting; strata seated with 0.08 penetration, no gaps.
evidence.V6: Single stone hue in 3 values (light tops, mid faces, dark base); colourways keep the same discipline.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material, designed flat facets and stone palette match the nature kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull (or Box per stratum), CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

top_fixes: Add a small-scale layer (a chip, crack notch or loose pebble at the base) to complete the hierarchy
Vary stratum thickness more so it reads less like a stacked cairn and more like a cliff section
